blocks.text: As we observe All Saints’ Day, our minds naturally turn to reflection, remembrance, and honoring the memories of those who have left an indelible mark on our lives. While it is a time traditionally reserved for sacred remembrance, it is also the perfect occasion for us pop culture aficionados to pause, look back, and pay our utmost respects to the cinematic saints—the larger-than-life icons, legends, and stars of Hollywood who have recently journeyed to the great silver screen in the sky.
